html:
Hello to my million plus readers out there. I am very excited that Prophecy’s End, the sixth and final book in my epic fantasy series, The Endarian Prophecy, goes live on Amazon and Audible on 8 December 2020. This was a fun ride to take my readers on and it was a bit sad to bring the curtain down on the series. Once again, Scott Merriman gave a fantastic audiobook performance. Enjoy.

Best,

Richard Phillips
